## Kyoto 5-Day Trip at a Glance

A 5-day Kyoto plan for **2 adults** with a total budget of **180,000 JPY**.
Your planned spend is **224,000 JPY**, so the trip is **44,000 JPY over budget**.

## Timeline and Cost Breakdown

Day 1: Arrival and local dinner — **18,000 JPY**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Focus: settle in, check-in, easy first evening.
- Budget check: within a typical day spend.

Day 2: Temple visits and transit — **12,000 JPY**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Focus: classic Kyoto sightseeing with rail/bus movement.
- Budget check: the lowest-cost day in the plan.

Day 3: Day trip and lunch — **22,000 JPY**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Focus: one out-of-city excursion plus meals.
- Budget check: moderate, still controlled.

Day 4: Museum and shopping — **30,000 JPY**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Focus: indoor activity plus souvenir and retail spend.
- Budget check: **highest daily cost** and the clearest overage risk.

Day 5: Tea ceremony and departure — **16,000 JPY**
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Focus: cultural activity, then checkout and departure.
- Budget check: reasonable, but depends on transport timing.

## Cost Breakdown Chart

| Category | Planned Cost (JPY) | Share of Total |
|---|---:|---:|
| Accommodation | 72,000 | 32.1% |
| Food | 28,000 | 12.5% |
| Transit | 14,000 | 6.3% |
| Misc | 12,000 | 5.4% |
| Day 1 | 18,000 | 8.0% |
| Day 2 | 12,000 | 5.4% |
| Day 3 | 22,000 | 9.8% |
| Day 4 | 30,000 | 13.4% |
| Day 5 | 16,000 | 7.1% |

## Budget Check

- **Budget limit:** 180,000 JPY
- **Planned total:** 224,000 JPY
- **Over budget by:** **44,000 JPY**

### Days that stand out
- **Day 4: 30,000 JPY** — biggest single-day spend
- **Day 3: 22,000 JPY** — also above the lower-cost days
- **Accommodation: 72,000 JPY** — largest category overall

### Simple adjustment target
- Reduce **Day 4 shopping** by about **20,000 JPY**
- Trim **misc/souvenirs** by **12,000 JPY**
- Lower **food** by **12,000 JPY**
- That would bring the plan back to budget
